messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT — Elevated 5xx + streaming disconnects detected on /v1/streaming (gateway). Paging #incidents and current on-call. Severity: S2. See dashboard: https://redwood.internal/d/streaming/streaming-errors

Maya: i'm looking — seeing a spike in 502/504 from the gateway around 23:04 UTC. errors concentrated in eu-west-1 and us-west-2.

Sanjay: confirm. traces show repeated upstream resets with chunked-encoding responses being terminated mid-stream. client cancellations also up ~3x.

Erin: customers reporting partial streams — tokens stop mid-response. any correlation with recent deploys?

Maya: no deploys in the last 6 hours. autoscaler didn't trigger any scale events either.

Jamal: grabbing gateway logs. sample from proxy: 
```
[23:04:12] conn_id=abcd1234 upstream_error=openresty: writev() failed: Broken pipe
[23:04:12] req=/v1/streaming?model=redwood-7b status=502
[23:04:12] downstream_client_cancel=0.2% upstream_cancel=7.4%
``` 
Ricardo: that's weird — upstreams report no host marked unhealthy. Could be transient network flaps or a kernel-level fd exhaustion. Check socket counts and epoll errors.

Maya: checking node metrics -> c10k metric for nginx shows file descriptor usage at ~96% on a few proxy hosts. epoll_wait latency also elevated.

Sanjay: that would explain chunked termination — kernel dropping connections. spinning up a small temp pool to avoid hitting fd limit. increasing `worker_rlimit_nofile` and restarting proxy gracefully on two nodes for live mitigation.

Erin: for customers: partial responses lead to corrupted chunk frames and client cancels. CS reported one paying customer saw ~12 failed streams in last hour. tagging them for follow-up.

CS-Bot: Notified account team for acct: Payflux (ticket #2345).

Jamal: applying mitigation now — `sudo systemctl reload openresty` on proxy-12 and proxy-07 after bumping limits. will monitor error rate.

Maya: also enabling gateway fallback policy to route traffic to dedicated fallback pool (lower capacity) to reduce load on affected proxies. rerouting config snippet: 
```
policy: fallback-on-5xx
match: path:/v1/streaming
actions:
  - route: fallback-pool
  - throttle: 80rps
```
Sanjay: running canary curl to validate streaming behavior after changes: 
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -N "https://gw.redwood.ai/v1/streaming?model=redwood-7b" \
  -d '{"prompt":"test","stream":true}'
```
Maya: curl shows continuous tokens now for 3 sequential runs on fallback pool. gateway 5xx rate dropped from 6.4% -> 1.1% in 8m.

Ricardo: good. still seeing occasional `client canceled` logs with upstream code 499 coming from mobile clients doing rapid reconnects. can we add a short debounce (200ms) on client connection retries to reduce thundering?

Erin: we'll push a client-side recommendation doc to CS and add a temporary rate-limit per source-ip to avoid noisy clients.

Jamal: i've also pushed a temporary rule to drop new long-poll streams that exceed 60s handshake time (protects backend kv cache pressure). rule id: tmp-protect-1919.

Maya: note: paging rotation, on-call handoff in 30m. Recommend keeping incident open until fd usage normalized across proxies and 5xx < 0.5% for 30m.

Sanjay: digging into root cause — kernel fd leak suspected, but i also see a spike in large payloads from a single partner integration. partner `voice-systems` sent several >4MB system prompts which increased buffer usage. correlating client IPs.

Erin: ops note: we should add a quota/validation to reject prompts >1MB for streaming endpoints. Create a follow-up todo.

CS-Bot: Payflux reported degraded streaming for 00:03–00:20 UTC, approx 17 calls affected. logged case for SRE follow-up.

Ricardo: monitoring dashboards now show epoll latency back to baseline after proxy reloads. will keep an eye on kernel dmesg for any OOM or soft errors.

Maya: rolling out a config change to permanently increase `worker_rlimit_nofile` on the fleet with 1% downtime window scheduled. planning a change window at 02:00 UTC if we see reoccurrence.

Sanjay: root cause hypothesis: combination of sudden large payloads + fd limit exhaustion causing chunked-encoding streams to be terminated which manifests as 502/504 and client cancellations. mitigation: throttle large prompts, increase fd limits, temporary fallback routing.

Erin: customer impact summary for status page: "Partial streaming interruptions observed for a subset of streaming requests in EU/US regions between 23:04–23:25 UTC. Impact: some responses cut off mid-stream (5xx/connection resets). Mitigation: traffic rerouted to fallback pool and proxies reloaded; monitoring in place. Investigating permanent fixes."

Jamal: handing off to night on-call (Ricardo). I'll add runbook links and exact node IDs to the incident ticket.

Ricardo: ack — taking over. i'll watch for recurrence and start a post-incident action list: 1) hard-limit prompt size on streaming 2) fleet-wide fd limit bump 3) add client retry guidance 4) add alert for chunked-encoding partial frames > threshold.

Maya: thanks team. closing on-call page in 10m if metrics stay stable. will open a postmortem if we need follow-up. :thumbsup:
